'''Slick''' was a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Alongside [[Dirk Harkness]], [[Trent Jaspar]], and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Allegra Amar]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] served at [[Edan Base]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].
